features.label: Was more than one person
features.detail: Wrote as dozens of invented authors with their own biographies and mutually contradicting philosophies.

features.label: Published almost nothing
features.detail: Left a trunk of 25,000 unsorted pages. What you read is an editor's arrangement, not his.

features.label: There is no real one
features.detail: Asking which heteronym is the true Pessoa has no answer. That absence is the project.
